investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Cedartrel Cloud (collaboration SaaS); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus2 (zones eastus2-1/eastus2-2/eastus2-3); network range 10.85.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster cedart-prod-eastus (AKS); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic export-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer export-worker, consumer audit-log-svc; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
